page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Main text in one column with a woodcut initial; marginal notes in the right margin (Passivum, Ponor, Ponebar, posit sum, Posita fueram). Paragraph tables of Greek verb forms below the text, in lines. Page number 14 printed at foot as a gathering-style mark.

main_text.head: VERBI PASSIVI.
main_text.p: Passivum.PRAESENS & imperfectum, seruata uocali indice, flectitur in omnibus modis sicut τύπτο- μαι ἐτυπτόμην, nisi quod secunda persona praesentis etiam in σαι finit. Imperfecti & imperatiui in σο. Et Optatiuum & Subiunctiuum penultimam, ubi potest, circunflectit.
main_text.head: Praesens Indicatiui.
Imperfectum.
main_text.l: ἐτιθέμην ἐτίθεσο ἢ ἐτίθου ἐτίθετο. Ponebar.
main_text.head: Perfectum.
Plusquamperfectum.

page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed approximately from a small, worn scan; accents and breathings in the tables are doubtful. Marginal notes are read as printed. The woodcut initial P is a decorated letter.
